newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Trading of Dah Bang shares suspended.
newsitem.headline: Trading of Dah Bang shares suspended.

text.p: Trading in shares of printing machinery distributor Dah Bang (Holdings) Ltd was suspended at the company's request pending an announcement, the Hong Kong stock exchange said on Friday.

The company said in a statement on Friday that it requested a trading suspension due to the company's public shareholding falling below the stock exchange requirement level of 25 percent following a cash offer by Golik Investments Ltd.

It said the public shareholding was less than 25 percent as Golik held 70.51 percent of Dah Bang's issued shares capital after the close of the offer on October 31, and two former Dah Bang executive directors and one existing executive director also held a total 15 percent of the company.
Dah Bang shares ended at HK$0.97 on Thursday.
